title: Complete Java Learning Roadmap - Coding Game Dataset
description: Syntax-to-output puzzle dataset covering a full practical Java roadmap (43 parts) mirroring the Python roadmap structure, plus bonus parts (built-in methods, design patterns, interview/competitive programming patterns). Each item has a topic name, a syntax snippet, and its expected output — meant to power a fill-in-the-blank / predict-the-output style coding game, basic to advanced. No theory, only practical runnable snippets.
